problem_statement: On the micro-ECC PSA Crypto backend, ECC public keys must be handled in standard SEC 1 uncompressed form, including the 0x04 prefix, for operations that use public keys through PSA. In particular, importing a valid P-256 public key that starts with 0x04 via psa_import_key() and then calling psa_verify_message() with a known message and signature must succeed; today that verification fails. Public keys generated by the backend should also be returned in the same standard SEC 1 uncompressed form, including the 0x04 prefix, so that they are usable by PSA Crypto users expecting standard public key encoding.
